mapper.insert: insert into post_bookmark (post_bookmark_seq, member_seq, post_seq, created_at, updated_at) values (seq_post_bookmark.nextval, #{memberSeq}, #{postSeq}, systimestamp, systimestamp)
mapper.sql: where b.member_seq = #{memberSeq} and p.is_deleted = 'N' and not exists ( select 1 from blacklist bl where bl.member_seq = p.member_seq and bl.released_at is null and bl.start_at <= systimestamp and (bl.end_at is null or bl.end_at > systimestamp))
mapper.select: select count(*) from post_bookmark b join post p on p.post_seq = b.post_seq

select post_bookmark_seq, post_seq, created_at, board_type, category, title, writer_name, view_count, recommend_count, comment_count, post_created_at from ( select rownum as rnum, t.* from ( select b.post_bookmark_seq, b.post_seq, b.created_at, p.board_type, p.category, p.title, case when p.board_type = 'ANON' then '익명' else m.nickname end as writer_name, p.view_count, p.recommend_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at as post_created_at from post_bookmark b join post p on p.post_seq = b.post_seq join member m on m.member_seq = p.member_seq
order by b.post_bookmark_seq desc ) t where rownum <= #{endRow} ) where rnum >= #{startRow}
